body:
## Summary

The fix for #15 (bare checksum matches get confidence 0.35 and are not replaced under the default `minConfidence: 0.5`) also turned off detection that #11 explicitly required. #11: "Russian SNILS (`ddd-ddd-ddd dd` with checksum) and INN (10/12 digits with checksum) without labels. With a `snils`/`inn` label both are detected; bare values such as `112-233-445 95` are not."

On main @ c9714cb:

| Input (synthetic, checksum-valid) | Result |
|---|---|
| `СНИЛС 112-233-445 95`, `snils 11223344595` | redacted ✅ |
| `112-233-445 95` | **unchanged** (`RU_SNILS` 0.35) |
| `пенсионное 112-233-445 95` (common Russian name of SNILS) | **unchanged** (0.35) |
| `value 500100732259` (12-digit personal INN) | **unchanged** (`RU_INN` 0.35) |

Plain 10-digit numbers matching INN/NHS/NPI checksums by chance are a different case from the SNILS shape. `ddd-ddd-ddd dd` with exactly that punctuation and a valid checksum almost never appears by accident in logs: it is strong structural evidence on its own, like a formatted credit card number. A 12-digit INN with two check digits passes by chance only about 1 in 100 times, unlike the 1-in-10 10-digit INN.

## Expected

- SNILS in its formatted shape `ddd-ddd-ddd dd` (and `ddd ddd ddd dd`) with a valid checksum scores ≥ 0.85 without context.
- 12-digit INN (two check digits) scores above the default threshold, or at least above it whenever any Russian-language text is in the same record. 10-digit INN stays low without context, as #15 requires.
- Add SNILS context words: `пенсионное`, `страховое свидетельство`, `СНИЛС`, `страховой номер`.
- Add a test asserting the confidence for each national-ID shape, so a future threshold change cannot silently disable a required detector. List the effective default behaviour per ID type in COVERAGE.md.
title: Regression from #15: bare formatted SNILS and 12-digit INN no longer redacted (required by #11)
